scope: V1 preparation protocol only; no evaluation inputs, labels, predictions, scoring, case selection, or scientific claims

prior_exposure.declaration: The operator has seen the detector and the disclosed Benchmark V2 development probes, including the 8-of-9 missed-probe limitation. This protocol was frozen before any Benchmark V3 probe, V3 ground truth, selected Case 002/003 evaluation label, arm prediction, or pilot result existed.

comparison_arms.description: The frozen NAAIL detector and assurance workflow version approved for the pilot.
comparison_arms.freeze_requirement: Commit, configuration, schemas, dependencies, and executable entry point must be hashed before any evaluation input is unsealed.

comparison_arms.description: At least two blinded evaluation coders operating under the approved B5 human-ground-truth instructions.
comparison_arms.independence_requirement: Evaluation coders must not author Benchmark V3 probes and must record any overlap with ground-truth coding or adjudication. Coder-level unadjudicated outputs are scored separately.
comparison_arms.freeze_requirement: Coder identities or stable pseudonyms, instructions, training materials, assignment rules, and blinding plan must be frozen before evaluation begins.

comparison_arms.description: Training-free deterministic baseline that predicts NO_ERROR and an empty taxonomy set for every evaluation item.
comparison_arms.freeze_requirement: No parameters, corpus statistics, labels, detector outputs, or post-unseal choices are permitted.

requirements: probes and ground truth independently authored without detector access
probe package and ground truth sealed and hashed before scoring
single scoring authorization recorded by Claude and the human
Cases 002 and 003 selected by the human under B3
case inputs, unitization rule, and ground truth frozen before scoring
no licensed-data result is silently replaced by public-data evidence

ground_truth.source: approved B4 holdout ground truth and approved B5 real-case ground-truth process
ground_truth.positive_class: item contains at least one material assurance error under the frozen label schema
ground_truth.negative_class: item contains no material assurance error under the frozen label schema

one_authoritative_run.failure_rule: The single invocation and all partial outputs remain authoritative evidence of failure. Repair requires a prospectively frozen new protocol version and explicit Claude and human authorization; the failed run is never replaced or hidden.

reporting_boundaries: Report every prespecified arm and stratum, including null, weak, negative, incomplete, and failed results.
Report raw TP, FP, FN, and TN alongside precision, recall, and F1.
Do not pool holdout and real-case strata into a single headline result.
Do not call a protocol, green CI, synthetic fixture, or elapsed time scientific validation.
Do not describe an arm as superior without the frozen paired comparison and uncertainty outputs.
Preserve Benchmark V2 as development evidence and disclose that 8 of 9 realistic evasion probes were missed.
execution_gate: Execution is prohibited until human POC approval, Claude approval of B4/B5/B6, approved and frozen B5 ground truth, independently authored sealed B4 holdout inputs, selected and frozen real cases, and a complete pre-run manifest exist.
